tagline: The playlist manager for JAV codes
intro: Keep your AV code collection organized. Create playlists, share them with friends, and generate links to your favorite video sites automatically.

whatIs.title: What is a JAV code?
whatIs.body: A JAV code (also called an AV code, product code, DVD ID or simply ID; 番號 in Chinese, 品番 in Japanese) identifies a Japanese adult video. It's the studio's label prefix plus a number, like SSIS-123 or IPX-920. FC2 titles use the FC2-PPV-1234567 format. Codes never change, so saving codes is far more reliable than saving links.

formats.title: Automatic detection and formatting
formats.body: Paste codes or video URLs, one per line. Case and hyphens are fixed for you, and duplicates are skipped:

add.title: Paste codes
add.body: Paste a batch of codes or video URLs, one per line. They're formatted for you, and duplicates are skipped.

links.title: Generate links
links.body: Pick the video sites you use, then open or copy the link for any code in one click.

share.title: Share and sync
share.body: Send a share link and your friend can open the list right away. Sign in with Google to sync your lists across devices.

free: Free, no sign-up. Your data lives in your browser; sign in with Google to sync it across devices.
heroNote: Free, no sign-up, works right away

screens.title: Made for phone and desktop
screens.body: Add it to your home screen and use it like an app.

alt.dashboard: My Lists page: every playlist with a preview of its codes
alt.playlist: Playlist page: code list with search and bulk actions
